Against the real attempt-002 capture (PDM1SPIHID count 0, query_errors true from the old bug): the new script would print the inventory JSON and then DLK_NOT_READY, with no misleading typing prompt.

Semantics: user matching returns only services in kIOServiceMatchedState (IOService::getMatchingServices calls copyExistingServices(kIOServiceMatchedState)), so count > 0 means PDM1SPIHID completed IOHIDDevice::start and registered after a successful enumeration.
limitation: count > 0 means the driver published at some point, not that it is still healthy. A later runtime fail() (CRC error, device reboot) leaves the instance registered, because terminate is refused, with PDM1KeyboardPhase/Error set. The tiny PDIOKitLib has no property getters, so the inventory cannot read those. That is acceptable because the gate controls only the prompt; the composite input proof is unchanged and the console 'stopped at' line remains visible.
not_claimed: The gate is never input evidence.
